english: Therefore either with the grown vines' layering
problem: adulta agrees with propagine (as the note says), but the English 'the grown vines'' attaches 'grown' to the vines.
suggested: Therefore either with the grown, of vines, layering

english: if any, thundering on the eastern waves,
problem: intonata is a perfect participle ('having thundered'); 'thundering' turns it present.
suggested: if any, having thundered on the eastern waves,

english: with this, having smeared gifts, avenging herself on her rival,
problem: delibutis donis is passive (ablative absolute, 'the gifts smeared with this'); 'having smeared gifts' reads as an active participle with Medea as the subject.
suggested: with this, gifts smeared, having avenged herself on her rival,

english: Although proud you may walk in your money,
problem: 'your' is supplied before 'money' and not noted; pecunia is an ablative of cause ('proud through money').
suggested: Although, proud through money, you may walk,

latin: neque hoc parentes, heu mihi superstites,
english: nor this, my parents, alas, who will outlive me,
problem: 'my' is supplied before 'parents' and not noted (mihi stands with superstites).
suggested: nor this, parents, alas, surviving me,
